The Offspring
Hellfest 2026

78 min.


Metal
Concert

Without this band, the Californian punk rock wave of the 1990s would never have happened: Once again, The Offspring come to the Hellfest for a brilliant show – fat guitar sounds and socially critical lyrics included.

The Offspring, with Nofx, Green Day and Rancid, is among the most important representatives of California's punk rock, continuing the protest tradition of the grunge of Nirvana. The band was formed in 1984 by Dexter Holland, followed ten years later by the breakthrough with Smash. The album is considered the central work of a punk revolution and was groundbreaking for the newly created subgenre Skate Punk, which with its own codes shaped the youth culture of the 1990s and 2000s. An entire generation was thrilled with headphones, torn jeans, metal chains and high-gelled hair for fast power chord riffs and mocking protest.

After a memorable gig at the Hellfest 2024, the Californian formation is now once again delighted by the audience in Clisson. A convenient opportunity for a good portion of nostalgia.

Record of 21. June 2026 at the Hellfest Open Air Festival, Clisson.
